limitations:
- The release gate rests on 41 holdout-synthetic positive(s); every interval is a server-cluster bootstrap, so it is wide by construction.
- test-ID is 105 real row(s) with no poisoned row: it measures false positives and the benign/imperative split, never recall.
- The LLM judge is deferred to v1.1 (D8): pipeline figures are Stage-1 only, and the band [T_low, T_high) is routed to review.
- Holdout-synthetic recall is 1.000 with a 95% lower bound of 1.000; read the lower bound, not the point.
- MCPTox (483 rows) is unlicensed: evaluated locally, never trained on.
